test_title: PYST 6: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight friends Vinit, Kamal, Raju, Abdul, Harprit, Vidhan, Satpal and Janit are sitting around a circular table facing the centre, but not necessarily in the same order. Janit is between Kamal and Vinit. Abdul is sitting at third left place of Vidhan. Vinit is at third right place of Vidhan. Raju is to the immediate right of Harprit. Satpal is between Abdul and Vinit. Who is sitting between Vinit and Abdul?
solution:
Persons: Vinit, Kamal, Raju, Abdul, Harprit, Vidhan, Satpal and Janit

1) Abdul is sitting at third left place of Vidhan.

2) Vinit is at third right place of Vidhan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eae0199ac897065c409c7789e32515e51d1281764dbaa92c3e42476d04cb4855.png] 

3) Janit is between Kamal and Vinit.

4) Satpal is between Abdul and Vinit.

5) Raju is to the immediate right of Harprit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81479c4dffd93cb2696f277025329638b0cc4f84e3470911c17d6c2575a33149.png] 

This is the final arrangement.

Hence, Satpal is sitting between Vinit and Abdul.
